verdict.rationale: A national IP office could reasonably publish a public API, for example for trade mark search or filing, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents human-facing online services: web filing behind One Login, email or post forms, and web search tools. The probe shows the trade mark search host blocks automated agents at robots.txt. No documented public API appears anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
